description:
Open a pending single-use escalation ticket (sba_*) when a delegated subagent needs one-time permission beyond standing caps or routes. Use this after x402_quote_plan flags human_approval_required=true; do not use to decide tickets (x402_decide_approval) or edit caps (x402_update_delegate_key).
Parameters: omit cents on fixed-SKU routes to auto-resolve price, or pass cents on dynamic routes; ttl_minutes sets pending decision window (default 30m, separate from 15m execution pass); supply spend_key/header (mismatch -> HTTP 400).
Behavior: zero charge, non-idempotent (max 50 pending/account -> HTTP 429); HTTP 401 invalid key, HTTP 404 unknown capability.

capability_id.description: Target capability_id or route key requiring one-time over-cap execution (e.g. "audio_visual_isolate" or "POST /audio/visual-isolate").

cents.description: Exact USD cent amount requested for approval (optional for fixed-SKU capabilities where the hub auto-resolves the exact price).

justification.description: Concise human-readable reason explaining why this one-time spend exception is required (shown to the operator in the /x402/ approval queue).

spend_key.description: Stripe-funded master or delegated subagent spend key (format: sbk_<43+ chars>). Optional when the caller supplies the x-atlas-spend-key HTTP header.

ttl_minutes.description: Minutes the pending ticket remains open awaiting operator decision (1 to 1440; defaults to 30 minutes when omitted).

name: x402_request_approval

ok.description: True when the pending escalation ticket was recorded.

title: Request Spend Escalation Approval
